root_causes.description: The email container in pod email-7699887dd9-rnbxw is being killed and restarted in a crash/back-off loop: K8s events show the container is terminated because its 'container definition changed' and then repeatedly fails to restart (Back-off restarting failed container email), while its caller (checkout) shows zero error propagation and sibling leaf services remain nominal.

evidence.query_or_id: BackOff: Back-off restarting failed container email in pod email-7699887dd9-rnbxw_otel-demo(c9cf2589-71fd-45ed-bb7c-39ada7acd0a9) (count=5)
evidence.observed_value: count=5 back-off restarts of the email container during the window
evidence.expected_baseline: 0 back-off/restart events for a healthy pod

evidence.query_or_id: Killing: Container email definition changed, will be restarted (count=2)
evidence.observed_value: count=2 container kills due to email container definition change
0.000 across the window (rolling churn not captured by the restart counter)
0.000 — no error propagation from email to its caller checkout
no logs found for email in the window (pod churn suppresses log emission)
evidence.expected_baseline: steady email logs with no error entries

root_causes.description: Secondary hypothesis: the email pod also shows image pull failures for the pause container (ErrImagePull / ImagePullBackOff on gcr.io/google-containers/pause:latest). This could contribute to pod instability, but the dominant signal is the container-definition-change kill, so image pull issues are most likely collateral rather than the root cause.

evidence.observed_value: count=6 image pull failures for the pause container
count=6 back-off attempts pulling the pause image

root_causes.description: Tertiary hypothesis: email memory working set shows transient elevation (p95/max ~154MB vs p50 ~41MB), which could indicate memory pressure. No OOMKilled events were observed and the dominant fault is the crash loop, so this is unlikely to be the root cause.

evidence.observed_value: mean=0.000, p99=0.001, max=0.001 cores — no CPU stress
evidence.expected_baseline: low idle CPU for a leaf service

evidence.observed_value: 0.000 — no server-side error rate spike recorded for email

remediation_steps: Run 'kubectl describe pod email-7699887dd9-rnbxw -n otel-demo' to read the restart/back-off events and container exit codes and confirm the pod is in CrashLoopBackOff.
Inspect the email container spec/ConfigMap for the recent 'container definition changed' trigger and roll back the change that forced repeated restarts.
Investigate why the pause image 'gcr.io/google-containers/pause:latest' cannot be pulled (ErrImagePull/ImagePullBackOff) to eliminate collateral pod instability.
After remediation, verify email pod stability via kube_pod_container_status_restarts_total and confirm checkout email-send calls complete without errors.
